import os,glob,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
# hypothesis: left region (cols < sep), every 9 -> 4, every 4 adjacent(8-dir) to a 9 -> 3, else 4
def f(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    # find separator: column of identical non-8 value spanning full height
    sep=None
    for c in range(w):
        v=g[0][c]
        if all(r[c]==v for r in g) and v!=8: sep=c; break
    L=[r[:sep] for r in g]; O=[[4]*sep for _ in range(h)]
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(sep):
            if L[i][j]==9: O[i][j]=4
            elif L[i][j]==4 and any(L[i+di][j+dj]==9 for di in(-1,0,1) for dj in(-1,0,1) if (di,dj)!=(0,0) and 0<=i+di<h and 0<=j+dj<sep): O[i][j]=3
    return O
print(f(G['Demo pair 1 input'])==G['Demo pair 1 output'])
out=f(G['Test input']); print(json.dumps(out))
